D. C. (Special Branch).
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____
                             C.I, C.B.H.Q. Station,
            REPORT           Date March 8, 1939
Subject ASSISTANCE TO JAPANESE MILITARY POLICE : ARREST OF 2 MALE CHINESE.

Made by D.S. Fowler    Forwarded by C.D.I. Grubb

Sir,
    At 6 a.m. 8th. March, 1939, Sgt. Major Katoda of the
Japanese Military Police and party attended Crime Branch
Headquarters for the purpose of visiting a certain address
in Kuling Road, per attached request.
    Assistance was rendered by D.S. Sugimoto (S.P.O.),
C.D.S.s 85 and 290 and the undersigned. Also attending
were Majors N.A. Edson and J.S. Monahan of Headquarters
4th. U.S. Marines inasmuch the address to be visited was
in the American Defense Sector.
    At 6.10 a.m. the party visited Lane 145/19 Kuling Road
and there took into custody one
    Hau Tsoh Ching (馬竹筠), 34, Zangzoh, m/shipping
manager, residing same address.
    A search of the premises proved fruitless in unearthing
anything of an incriminating nature regarding guerilla
activities.
    A request was then made by Sgt. Major Katoda to visit
Lane 642/3 Chengtu Road in order to arrest an accomplice.
Majors Edson and Monahan also attended as the address
given was in the American Defense Sector.
    On visiting this address at 6.40 a.m. one named
Tseu Yoh Voong (周毓文), alias Loh Tsung Jeu (陸振球),
34, Zangzoh, m/rice merchant, residing that address,
was taken into custody.
    The 1st. arrest admitted knowing the 2nd. arrest.
    A search of the premises proved fruitless regarding
anything for an incriminating nature.
    At this stage Sgt. Major Katoda requested assistance to

                             C.I, C.B.H.Q. 分局，
            报告           日期 1939年3月8日
主题 协助日本宪兵：逮捕两名中国男子。

制作人 D.S. Fowler    转呈人 C.D.I. Grubb

先生：
    1939年3月8日上午6时，日本宪兵军曹长 Katoda 及其随行人员抵达刑事调查总部，目的是根据所附请求，前往牯岭路某地址进行查访。
    提供协助的有警探 Sugimoto（特别警务官）、刑事侦探社警员第85号和第290号以及本人。美国海军陆战队第四团总部的 N.A. Edson 少校和 J.S. Monahan 少校也一同前往，因为拟查访的地址位于美方防区范围内。
    上午6时10分，一行人前往牯岭路145弄19号，并在该处拘捕了一名男子：
    Hau Tsoh Ching（馬竹筠），34岁，浙江籍，未婚，航运经理，居住于同一地址。
    对该住所的搜查未能发现任何与游击队活动有关的罪证。
    随后，Katoda 军曹长要求前往成都路642弄3号，以逮捕一名同伙。Edson 少校和 Monahan 少校也一同前往，因为所提供的地址位于美方防区内。
    上午6时40分到达该地址后，拘捕了一名名为 Tseu Yoh Voong（周毓文）的男子，别名 Loh Tsung Jeu（陸振球），34岁，浙江籍，未婚，米商，居住于该地址。
    第一名被捕者承认认识第二名被捕者。
    对该住所的搜查未能发现任何具有定罪性质的物品。
    此时，Katoda 军曹长请求协助

to effect the arrest of a further person,
Zau Voong Ping (趙文彬)
whom the first arrested male admitted knowing.
The party returned to Crime Branch Headquarters whereupon
Majors Edson and Monahan were given particulars of the men
arrested.
The undersigned communicated with C.D.I. Grubb and permission
was given to accompany the Japanese Military Police to the
address in French Concession.
With the assistance of M. Valentine and C.D.S. 99 of the
French Police (Lokawei), Lane 613/42 Avenue Joffre was visited
at 8.10 a.m. but only with the attendance of D.S. Sugimoto. The
party of Japanese Military Police remained at Lokawei.
The visit proved fruitless in locating Zau Voong Ping who,
it was learned from his father Zau Loh Ih (趙洛怡), had left
the house on the 7th. inst. to visit friends. The time of his
return was not known. The party then returned to Lokawei and
thence to Crime Branch Headquarters.
Questioned there the 1st. arrest denied being in anyway
concerned in guerilla activities. He stated he has been in the
cloth business in Zang-zoh which is operated by his grandfather
and father under the firm name of Mau Yoong Wu (馬永武).
Five months ago (November 1938) he invested $10, 000 in the
Foh Shing Navigation Company with offices at Room 6 , No.53
Szechuen Road. He became manager of the company.
The 2nd. arrest strenuously denied being concerned with
guerilla activities. Until 1934 he studied for the law and became

前往法租界霞飞路613弄42号，以逮捕另一名人员，
Zau Voong Ping（趙文彬）
第一名被捕男子承认认识此人。
一行人返回刑事调查总部，随后向 Edson 少校和 Monahan 少校通报了被捕人员的详细情况。
本人与 C.D.I. Grubb 联系，并获得许可，陪同日本宪兵前往法租界的上述地址。
在法国警察（卢家湾）的 M. Valentine 和第99号刑事侦探社警员的协助下，于上午8时10分前往霞飞路613弄42号，但仅有警探 Sugimoto 随行。日本宪兵一行留在卢家湾。
此次查访未能找到 Zau Voong Ping，据其父 Zau Loh Ih（趙洛怡）称，他已于本月7日离家拜访朋友。归期未定。随后一行人返回卢家湾，继而返回刑事调查总部。
经讯问，第一名被捕者否认参与任何游击队活动。他表示自己一直在浙江从事布料生意，该生意由其祖父和父亲以“馬永武”为商号经营。
五个月前（1938年11月），他在四川路53号6室的佛兴轮船公司投资了10,000美元。他成为该公司经理。

he became inactive and, in November 1938 he invested $500
of a total of $4,000 with a number of friends who purchase

Detailed statements will be taken from them and checked
upon.
It was learned from Sgt. Major Katoda that about 20th.
February, 1939 the Japanese Military Police of the western
area arrested one named
Kau Yoong Sau (高荣生), 52, Shantung, Morphine
trafficker, residing Zangzoh
in the Western District of Shanghai. He was subsequently handed
over to the Headquarters of the Japanese Military Police and
admitted being a liaison officer for guerillas in and around
Shanghai. He implicated the two arrested males and was the
reason for the request of the Japanese Military Police that
they be taken into custody with assistance of the S.M.P.
The two arrested males are meanwhile being detained in
the cells at Central Station.

AW Stowle

成为律师，但1938年8月因病停止执业。1938年11月，他与数位朋友共同投资4,000美元，其中他出资500美元，这些朋友在浙江及周边地区购买大米并运至上海转售。
将向他们获取详细供词并进行核实。
据 Katoda 军曹长告知，约在1939年2月20日，日本宪兵西区分队在上海西区逮捕了一名名为
Kau Yoong Sau（高荣生），52岁，山东籍，吗啡贩子，居住于浙江
的男子。随后他被移交给日本宪兵总部，并承认是上海及周边地区游击队的联络员。他供出了这两名被捕男子，这也是日本宪兵请求工部局警务处协助将其拘捕的原因。
目前，这两名被捕男子被羁押在中央分局的拘留室中。

AW Stowle
